events.comment:
To load track data from a save code, specific events are triggered. If you've added a new variable in the trackconf or another block and want it to be loaded in the game scene, you must first save it, as described in the SaveCodeLE comments.

Once you've created an event to save object variable values to the save code, you can load them by following these steps:

1- Add an event to the "Load certain variables to blocks" group.
2- Set the event condition to verify the block name for which you want to load the variables.
3- Set the event action to change the variable of the Block group, using the name of the variable you want to change.
4- Retrieve the saved values using SaveLoadArrayPos, starting with the first value at position [2] and incrementing the number to access subsequent values. 

For example, to retreive the second object variable saved, use SaveLoadArrayPos[3]

parameters:
"--
Name: "+SaveLoadArrayPos[0]+"; Position: "+SaveLoadArrayPosition[0]+", "+SaveLoadArrayPosition[1]+", "+SaveLoadArrayPosition[2]+"; Variables: id:"+SaveLoadArrayPos[2]+", finish:"+SaveLoadArrayPos[3]+", jump:"+SaveLoadArrayPos[4]
